verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships an official `npx skills` CLI with extensive first-party documentation. It covers `add`, `use`, `list`/`ls`, `find`, `update`, `remove`, and `init`, plus agent targeting, global or project scope, and non-interactive `-y` CI mode. It is built for AI-native workflows, for example piping a skill prompt into `claude`. Community threads confirm the `npx skills` installer is real and widely used. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that the commands work as documented, and stable (non-experimental) lockfile/version-pinning support.
